remarks: A Rare Find in Greenwich!  Located in the desirable Rockybrook Woods Association, this 3-bedroom condo is truly rare in Greenwich-offering more space and flexibility than typically available at this price. Featuring gleaming, recently refinished hardwood floors throughout, the unit includes a relaxing deck, stylish kitchen and baths, and a flowing layout. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the dining and living areas, perfect for everyday living and entertaining.  Residents enjoy a community pool, a common lounge and game area, plus a spacious private storage closet in the basement. Conveniently close to Cos Cob restaurants, shopping, schools, library, and parks. Don't miss this exceptional opportunity!
